texts.zh:
如果我们同意，[tutorial_mercenary_fleet.GetName]马上可以建立佣兵城邦，舰船也将不再受我们控制，重新成为独立性军事力量，并且可以重新向包括我们在内的所有国家租借佣兵舰队。

如果我们划出一片区域给佣兵城邦，那么只要它们把佣兵舰队租借给其他国家，我们就可以赚取收入。如果我们选择自己租借舰队，我们将在一定时间内保留对该舰队的控制权。另外如果雇佣舰队目前不可用，帝国需要额外支付一笔费用。
texts.en:
[tutorial_mercenary_fleet.GetName] is now capable of becoming a Mercenary Enclave, if we so wish. The fleet would cease to be under our direct control - instead it would become an independent force, capable of loaning out Mercenary Fleets to empires including our own.

For as long as we share space with the Mercenary Enclave, we stand to earn income whenever it loans its Mercenary Fleet out to other empires. If we choose to hire the Mercenary Fleet ourselves, we will retain control of that fleet for a set period of time. Empires may pay extra to buy out an existing contract if the Mercenary Fleet is not currently available.
